title: Example 2
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM

Confirm your entries.

The correspondence is created.

Example
Example 1

A customer informs you that she has recently married and informs you of her new last name. She requests written confirmation
that her data has been changed. Once the clerk has entered the new name in the field Last Name (BUTOOO-NAME_LAST) in the

transaction Change Business Partner , he creates a correspondence that documents the change made and sends it to the
customer.

Example 2

A tenant informs you that the bank details for the collection authorization that you have will change in two months. The clerk
enters the new bank details in the field Bank Details ID for incoming payments (field FKKVKP-EBVTY) in the transaction Contract

Account and schedules the change for the date specified. Using the correspondence for master data changes he informs the
tenant about the change planned in the system.

Contract Account and Contract Special Features for IS-U

This documentation section contains information about enhancements and variations from the FI-CA contract account and
contract, which apply specifically to SAP Utilities (IS-U).

Contracts (IS-U)

Definition

Contracts in IS-U.

Use

Contracts represent the entities that are billed. You can bill one or more contracts together using a contract account.
Structure

You can divide the data from contracts into three categories:

e General data

e Data relevant to billing (business)

e Data regarding move-in and move-out.
Integration

Contracts are linked to installations in |S-U; these installations contain technical data with regard to billing. In the case of a move-
